classification.vuln_type: assert-abort (failed allocation dereferenced — bounded resource pool exhausted)
classification.impact: DoS (UPF crash; service disruption for all sessions)

trigger.message: 4097-th PFCP Session Establishment Request after the per-UPF session pool (default cap = 4096) has been filled
trigger.ie_path: N/A (resource-creating request; payload contents don't matter — empty rules also trigger per the issue)
trigger.field: PFCP session object slot. ogs_pool_alloc returns NULL once 4096 sessions are live; upf_sess_add then `ogs_assert(sess)` instead of returning a Cause = 'No Resources Available'. PC1 'Resource Exhaustion' — exact match to the pattern's 'fatal error on count >= MAX, or dereferencing a failed allocation' wording.
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established with the UPF; 4096 prior Session Establishment Requests succeeded (pool full)

root_cause.note: Originating defect: ogs_pool_alloc returned NULL on full pool. The caller should reject the SER with Cause = 'No Resources Available' instead of asserting. The 4096 cap comes from ogs_app()->pool.sess in the default config.
